content.text: {"id": "mm7140e1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The percentage of positive RV/EV test results approximately doubled from week 32 (15.8%) to 35 (31.4%)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The percentage of ED visits among children and adolescents aged 0–4 and 5–17 years that were associated with ARI has been qualitatively elevated"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The percentage of positive RV/EV test results approximately doubled from week 32 (15.8%) to 35 (31.4%)"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "These observations were consistent when assessing numbers of ED visits with ARI and asthma/RAD rather than percentages"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "as of September 20, 2022, RV/EV was detected in 1,492 (26.4%) of these patients"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "qualitatively elevated from week 15 through week 37 of 2022 (the endpoint of available data) compared with 2018–2020"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "descriptive analyses of longitudinal trends compared with previous years were conducted"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "title", "q": "Increase in Acute Respiratory Illnesses Among Children and Adolescents"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "descriptive analyses of longitudinal trends compared with previous years were conducted and stratified by age group and geographic region, where available"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "quality control filters were applied to allow comparison across years"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "NSSP applies data quality filters to account for fluctuations attributable to site and facility onboarding and outages."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth"]}
